allocation_policy: module/global score workspace and output are prepared before timed events; identical for reference and any future candidate
synchronization: current CUDA stream; warmup; event start/end; synchronize after end event
dropout_policy: primary boundary fixes p=0; nonzero dropout requires a separate RNG-versioned contract
rank_policy: single-process local core qualification; no collectives inside boundary
future_candidate_rule: shared orchestration and exact semantic boundary; only local core implementation may differ
